shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用外盒加软管的完整到手形态建立合规主图。
主图一秒法则：斜置产品加左列三行图标标题，一眼给出三条核心卖点。
shots.textZone: left column, three stacked headline slots aligned to the icons

shots.intent: 用无身份的局部肤况特写放大粗糙堵塞的困扰，把观众带进问题现场。
保留双栏同光同框的分屏结构，让使用前后差异一眼可读。
shots.textZone: blank headline band on top plus two blank label plates under the panels

shots.intent: 把产品放进淋浴间瓷砖现场，用清凉场景完成自我代入。
用四宫格加中心圆章同时演示面部与身体用法，扩宽适用人群。
用膏体泡沫微距证明出质绵密，把清洁力转成可视化证据。
以平铺加留空凭证栏承接信任信息，供后端填入真实检测与配方资料。
以三步导视把单品放进护理流程，做出连带选购与规格选择位。
shots.textZone: three short step labels along the arrow ends

shots.intent: 用高饱和天空底加留白标题带和空白按钮收口，承接活动文案下单。
shots.textZone: upper-left headline band plus bottom offer strip with one CTA plate

style.backgroundSystem: solid flat colour fields in #F4711E and #232C5C, glossy ceramic tile in #8AD7EF, seamless #FFFFFF packshot field, matte pale board #EFE9E4; no scenic blur
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in #FFFFFF inside solid #232C5C circles, one icon per claim row
style.lightingSystem: bright hard-key studio daylight around 5600K, directional from upper left, crisp short defined contact shadows, controlled highlights, no hazy glow
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent high-energy clinical skincare ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of vivid orange #F4711E, deep navy #232C5C, pool-tile blue #8AD7EF and clean #FFFFFF; bright hard-key studio daylight near 5600K from the upper left with crisp short defined contact shadows and controlled highlights; modern geometric sans-serif with copy handled only as placeholders or added in post; thin single-weight line icons in #FFFFFF inside solid #232C5C circles; backgrounds limited to flat colour fields, glossy ceramic tile and matte pale board; product shown upright or on a consistent slight 3/4 diagonal with stable scale and label facing camera; blank label plates and empty credential frames instead of any rendered claim; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no soft lifestyle haze.
noDrift: no soft lifestyle haze or bloom
style.presentationRules: product upright or on a consistent slight 3/4 diagonal, stable scale across the set, label facing camera, never occluded by props or hands
style.surfaceSystem: glossy ceramic tile, matte pale board #EFE9E4, matte light grey surface #EDEDEA, saturated orange laminate #F4711E
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, heavy condensed display scale, copy carried only by placeholders or added in post
